neighbours.label: a discourse aside that qualifies a statement (mind you; really; of course), as opposed to the same words in their plain sense
fire: These are not fine cars, mind you.
A small loss, really, in the end.
The town centres on the sea, of course, so bring a towel.
The idea (a contradiction really) is popular.
It was, of course, too late.
He is a good singer, mind you.
The film was, really, a mess.
Life here is quiet, of course, in winter.
quiet: These are not fine cars, I think now.
She really likes the small town.
The town has a golf course near the sea.
He changed his mind about singing.
The film really was a mess.
Life here is quiet in winter.

short: asides: mind you, really, of course
notes: Not probed. The card is mixed (' stretch', ' fare', ' thinking'), so this tests an idea read from the top examples.
